The detenu was arrested on 29-2-95 in connection with Motijheel Police Station Case No. 105(2)96 under section 4 of the Explosive Substances Act and he was also shown arrested in Motjheel Police Station Case No. 106(2) under section 19(f) of the Arms Act and was forwarded to jail hajat. Thereafter the District Magistrate, Dhaka issued an order of detention in Misc. Case No. 526 of 1996 on 2-3-96 for detention of the detenu under section 3(2) of the Special Powers Act, 1974 and the grounds of detention were served on him on 12-3-96. Thereafter, the Government in the Ministry of Home Affairs through its memo No. 2045 Sha: Ma: (Nira-3) dated 17-3-96 under the signature of a senior Assistant Secretary (Security) approved the detention as ordered by the District Magistrate and extended the detention for a further period of 3 months with effect from 1-4-96. 

 4. The Rule is therefore made absolute. We direct that the detenu Babu be set at liberty at once if not wanted in connection with any other case.
